body.statement: In any fixed stratum of the rank-one design submodel, generic recovery of the full \(W\)-indexed bridge holds if and only if \(q_x=d\) and \(\operatorname{TreePack}_d(G)\) holds. If \(q_x<d\), no addition of randomized comparison edges can recover the full bridge in that stratum, although selected target contrasts may still satisfy \(\ker(A_P)\subseteq\ker(R_0)\).
body.justification: The corollary separates full nuisance recovery from identification of the causal functional.
body.gap: Finite-proxy rank results do not distinguish graph saturation of effective coordinates from full bridge recovery in a trial network.
body.consumer: NETMOTION analysts can see why additional trials may identify clinically relevant contrasts without ever identifying every proxy-indexed bridge coordinate.
